===Colors===
The <code>type</code> parameter determines the color of the infobox. The options are:
*Athlete
*Bounty hunter
*Bureaucrat
*Chiss Ascendancy
*CIS
*Confederation
*Corporate
*Criminal
*Dark Jedi
*Dathomiri
*Eternal Empire
*First Order
*Galactic Empire
*Galactic Republic
*GFFA
*Hutt Cartel
*Infinite Empire
*Je'daii
*Jedi
*Mandalorian
*Musician
*New Republic
*Nihil
*Pet
*Rebel
*Resistance
*Sith
*Sith Empire
*Yuuzhan Vong

===Usage===
====Required parameters====
Paste the following code into the top of an article, filling all known fields:
<pre><nowiki>{{Top}}
{{Character
|type=
|image=
|name=
|homeworld=
|birth=
|death=
|species=
|gender=
|pronouns=
|height=
|mass=
|hair=
|feathers=
|eyes=
|skin=
|cyber=
|families=
|parents=
|partners=
|siblings=
|children=
|affiliation=
|masters=
|apprentices=
}}</nowiki></pre>

*Note that a character may have multiple homeworlds&mdash;it could be the world on which they were born, and also the world on which they were raised.
*Per [[Forum:CT:Partner Field CT - Part the Second]], additions to the partners field should meet at least one of the criteria defined on '''[[Template:Character/doc/partners]]'''.
*The parents, siblings, and children fields may include adopted individuals.
*Affiliations that a character stopped abiding by should '''not''' be specified with "{{C|formerly}}" or "{{C|renounced}}" as Wookieepedia treats everything as having happened in the past, and in the interest of maintaining consistency and avoiding clutter.

====Optional parameters====
*If applicable, a {{Para|donor}} parameter may be added between {{Para|pronouns}} and {{Para|height}} to showcase individual(s) from which the article subject was cloned, '''not''' their biological or cultural parental figure. Example for [[Luuke Skywalker]]:
<pre><nowiki>
|donor=[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]
</nowiki></pre>
:→<small>See [[Forum:CT:Clones and Infoboxes - Part One]]</small>

*If applicable, the following parameters may be added between {{Para|cyber}} and {{Para|families}} to document a character's musical information.
<pre><nowiki>
|genre=
|instruments=
|songs=
|albums=
|collaboration=
</nowiki></pre>
*For pet characters, an {{Para|owners}} parameter may be added at the end of the template. This field should '''not''' be used for enslaved individuals.
:→<small>See [[Forum:CT:Merging the Pet infobox with Character]]</small>

*If applicable, an infobox gallery can be added, '''pursuant to the requirements outlined in the [[Wookieepedia:Layout Guide/In-universe|in-universe Layout Guide]]'''.
<pre><nowiki>
|image=
|option1=
|image2=
|option2=
|image3=
|option3=
</nowiki></pre>
:→<small>See [[Forum:CT:Infobox image galleries]]

===Example===
{{Character
|type=Galactic Republic
|image=[[File:Padmegreenscrshot.jpg]]
|caption=XXX
|name=Padmé Amidala
|homeworld=[[Naboo]]
|birth=[[46 BBY]], Naboo
|death=[[19 BBY]], [[Polis Massa]] {{C|2 [[Standard day|days]] after [[Empire Day]]}}
|species=[[Human]] {{C|[[Naboo (people)|Naboo]]}}
|gender=[[Gender|Female]]
|pronouns=She/her
|height=1.65 [[meter]]s (5 [[Foot|ft]] 5 in)
|mass=
|hair=[[Color|Brown]]
|feathers=
|eyes=Brown
|skin=Light
|cyber=
|families=*[[Naberrie family]]
*[[Skywalker family]] {{C|through [[marriage]]}}
|parents=*[[Jobal Naberrie]]
*[[Ruwee Naberrie]]
|spouses=[[Anakin Skywalker]]
|siblings=[[Sola Naberrie]]
|children=*[[Luke Skywalker]]
*[[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo]]
|affiliation=*[[Refugee Relief Movement]]
*[[Apprentice Legislature]]
*[[Legislative Youth Program]]
*[[Royal House of Naboo]]
*[[Galactic Republic]]
**[[Naboo delegation]]
**[[Loyalist Committee]]
**[[Delegation of 2,000]]
|masters=[[Mina Bonteri]] {{C|mentor}}
|apprentices=
}}

}}
